parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of departments to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Send the same filters that the previous request used.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filters that choose which departments are returned. The only supported field is is_active, with the values "true" and "false" and the operator EQUALS. Multiple values OR within a filter. Multiple filters AND together. Without an is_active filter, only active departments are returned. To return active and inactive departments, send [{"field":"is_active","values":["true","false"]}].

schema.description: Filters on department fields, combined with AND.

items.description: One filter on a department field.

field.description: The department field to filter on. The only supported field is is_active.

values.description: The values to match. A department matches when any value matches.

items.description: "true" matches active departments. "false" matches inactive departments.

operator.description: The only supported operator is EQUALS. Defaults to EQUALS.

items.title: PlatformDepartmentFilter
